independentNumericalChecks.method: NumPy least squares independently recomputed directly from the raw numbers printed in the task; symbolic monotonicity and counterexamples derived by this reviewer.

projectile.conclusion: Printed reference fits, interval velocities and scale sensitivities agree. Few tracking/scale variants remain sensitivity tests rather than confidence/guaranteed error intervals.

causeNonidentifiability.perspectiveExample: A uniform physical motion x=t under projective mapping u=x/(1+0.1x) produces u=t/(1+0.1t), with u_second_derivative=-0.2/(1+0.1t)^3.
causeNonidentifiability.indistinguishableAlternative: An orthographic recording of an actually nonuniform physical motion X=t/(1+0.1t) yields the same image coordinate history.
causeNonidentifiability.result: One image sequence/residual pattern alone cannot select perspective versus actual acceleration. A geometrically verified planar calibration/alignment or appropriate independent motion measurement adds discriminating information; another unchecked video need not.

velocityArrows.conclusion: Equal 0.5 m/s speed magnitudes yield nonzero vector changes. The two supplied calibrated clips still need independent learner marking and construction; own calibration is not added.

lens.intervalProof: For b=fg/(g-f), db/df=g²/(g-f)²>0 and db/dg=-f²/(g-f)²<0 on the physical g>f>0 region. Thus with g_min>f_max>0, endpoints are b(f_min,g_max), b(f_max,g_min).

invalidIntervalCounterexample_cm.reason: The box contains g=f, e.g. f=g=10 cm, so a pole destroys a finite full-box prediction band. Fresh actual control/reset is required, not fabricated bounds.

nearBlurCounterexample.result: The near image is behind the retina but the far limit lies in front: near blur alone does not establish the relaxed hyperopia model.

lens.fairness: Two actual own trials and genuine control remain essential. Agreement, resolved difference and unresolved position after own control are equally admissible; no desired measurement result is prescribed. Inconsequential slips are explicitly allowed in both solution languages.
